what: N7: the naming model is set once in Exosurface's configuration and shared by every profile, not in a profile's configuration the way the compactor is; per-profile naming model choice is dropped.
why: Pinned OptChat keeps only the keys it knows in a profile config, so a naming model set there is dropped on the next OptChat settings save and the configured model silently reverts to the default, breaking the owner ruling never to substitute a model silently. Decided by the owner (Tom, 2026-11-04 19:58 MST), approved as the final design (one profile maps to one surface); the owner's own amendment PR #93 (0d02d99, Accept hmw2yorzntyep) carries the N7 text, so this lane's branch holds main's spec unchanged.
evidence: OptChat aae1caf src/profiles.ts:51-55 loadConfig returns only compactor, subagent and the typed SETTINGS keys (settings.ts), dropping 'namer'; src/settings-page.ts:117-120 saves that filtered config via src/index.ts:524-526 and profiles.ts:46 saveConfig. Code review of PR #91 head 01ff2ad, class silent-model-substitution.

what: E10: a turn that draws or changes no page is on the page in view when the person sent it or pressed its button; a turn that draws or changes pages is on those pages (E1). Drops 'as well as on each page it draws or changes' for a send from a page in view; criteria unchanged.
why: As written, E10 puts a later turn on the kept page the person sent it from even when that turn draws another page, so the kept page's Exo block would show the later message, which acceptance-exo-block-own-page forbids ('nothing of the later message or its reply'). The owner's choice for E10 (option A, 2026-11-08) was about a reply that draws nothing; this keeps that and ends the contradiction.
evidence: Two contradicting spec lines at accepted c96df8a: #exo-block-sent-page E10 'A turn the person sends while a page is in view is on that page, as well as on each page it draws or changes' vs #acceptance-exo-block-own-page 'When the person sends a message about another topic ... then opens the kept page ... Then the kept page's Exo block shows the message that made it ... and nothing of the later message or its reply'. Implementer report #187 (f4deadb): the #134 test expects week's block to keep 'draw week' after 'draw garden' was sent with week in view.
